text:
ana: Quick update — we've published the Private v2.5 Compliance Kit to the internal compliance drive. Kit includes FedRAMP-readiness artifacts, a customer-facing compliance FAQ, and an NDA addendum template. Pilot customers can request the full evidence pack under NDA.

sam: Security summary: kit contains crypto primitives list, supported KMS/HSM integrations, recommended network ACLs for air-gapped installs, and pentest coordination notes. Reminder: FedRAMP Authorization still in progress; do not say 'FedRAMP certified' to customers.

laura: Legal note: approved customer-facing phrasing is in the kit. Use the addendum if sharing SOC2/FedRAMP readiness artifacts. Sales/legal FAQ will be posted to the sales playbook; ETA 48h.

jia: Ops/installer note: new airgap installer image and a hashed bundle signature are included. Short install example for customers is in the doc. For pilot tenants we provide an export script to produce tenant-specific evidence.

maria: CS play: CSMs — use the 1-page migration checklist in the kit when engaging customers. We're offering 6 hrs of free migration support for pilot participants; please collect KMS type and network posture up front.

oliver: Canary/ops: runbook and canary schedule live under /runbooks/private-v2.5-canary.md. Oncall for pilot week: @oliver primary, @jia backup. Ops action: snapshot DB before upgrades, enable extended logs for 12h post-upgrade.

deploy-bot: "artifact: compliance-kit/private-v2.5 uploaded by ana at 2026-04-05T14:00Z"

ana (small correction): tagging @sam for a short cryptography blurb to reuse in customer comms — can you add that to the kit?

sam: On it; will add a one-paragraph summary of supported algorithms, key sizes, and KMS patterns today.

maria: Reminder: we're deprecating the legacy non-VPC appliance in 6 months; add a migration note in customer outreach. We'll provide tooling and extended support options.

ana: Internal walkthrough scheduled Thu 10:00 PT — technical deep-dive + Q&A. Please RSVP if you're handling pilot customers.

ana: If you're not directly involved but want the summary, react :eyes: and we'll send the short kit summary and recording after the walkthrough.
